description: Ground-truth evaluation set for citation verification. Each case pairs a verbatim claim from a real citing paper with the real paper it cites, plus a structured-metadata-justified ground-truth label.

label_definitions.RETRACTED: The cited paper is retracted (Retraction Watch record). Tool should flag retraction.
label_definitions.SCOPE_MISMATCH: The claim asserts a human/clinical finding but the cited paper's MeSH organism scope is animal-only (no 'Humans'). Tool should flag species scope mismatch.
label_definitions.SUPPORTED: Negative control: cited paper is NOT retracted, scope matches (human claim -> human study), and the claim is consistent with the cited paper. Tool should PASS (no flag). Measures false-positive rate/specificity.

provenance_labels.metadata-grounded: Ground truth read directly from a structured record (Retraction Watch RetractionNature/Reason/Date; MeSH tags; OpenAlex is_retracted).
provenance_labels.model-inferred component: The cited-side fact is metadata-grounded, but the claim-side judgement (does the claim over-generalize / is it supported) is a model reading of claim text and is flagged.
